reuse.why: All providers reuse the new linking guards and existing bank lookup and sync helpers, but Fintegra copies orchestration and takeover copies local unlinking.

duplication.why: The change adds duplicate account-link orchestration, transaction-download plumbing, and the account fields cleared by unlinking.

placement.why: Server operations follow existing account modules, but the Fintegra type belongs outside simplefin.ts and local detachment should be shared with unlinkAccount.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the four requested linking and provider changes.

maintainability.why: Centralized guards help maintenance, but a validation-named helper now mutates accounts and duplicated provider workflows create additional maintenance points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureAccountIsNotLinked duplicates unlinkAccount's local detachment operation to avoid its provider cleanup instead of extracting a shared local-detachment definition.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions compact and reshape existing provider workflows while retaining their duplicated logic.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a takeover branch that changes it from a guard into a mutating operation; all six linking handlers still use the shared guards.
